title: Third Party Rising
tagline: Found a party in any town in America. Take on the machines. Work your way up.
disclaimer: Third Party Rising is a game, a work of fiction built on public statistics. It is not a voting guide, not a forecast and not election information. Real office-holders appear by name, party and office only; everything that happens to anyone in the game is invented and happens only to fictional characters.

ops.name: Canvass county
ops.help: Volunteers knock on doors across the county. Raises awareness of your party. Works better with more volunteers there.

ops.name: Canvass the town
ops.help: Door to door in one town. Builds the local roots that win council and mayoral races.

ops.name: Recruit volunteers
ops.help: Sign up volunteers in this county. Volunteers power canvassing and petitions, and cost a little to keep going.

ops.name: Hold a fundraiser
ops.help: Raises money from supporters in this county. Bigger where you have more support.

ops.name: Petition drive
ops.help: Volunteers collect ballot-access signatures in this county.

ops.name: Hold a rally
ops.help: Your leader speaks. Raises awareness, name recognition and a little reputation.

ops.name: Court a donor
ops.help: Two weeks of lunches. If it works, a donor gives every month.

ops.name: Campaign push
ops.help: Ten days of concentrated campaigning for one of your candidates.
